name: refactor_python_duplicate_retry_to_decorator
description: Three copy-pasted retry loops -> one @retry decorator; drift broken retries every exception instead of only ConnectionError
prompts: client.py contains three fetch functions that each hand-roll the identical retry loop: try the call, retry on ConnectionError, give up and re-raise after 3 total attempts. Extract the duplication into ONE decorator named `retry` in the same module - `@retry(attempts=3)` (or an equivalent default) applied to fetch_profile, fetch_orders, and fetch_invoices, whose bodies shrink to their single get(...) call. Pure refactor: at most 3 total attempts, the ConnectionError re-raised after the 3rd, ONLY ConnectionError retried (any other exception must propagate on the first attempt), each function still calling its own URL. Keep the three public function names and signatures.
